name: CloudTalk
summary: Cloud call centre with call routing, analytics and CRM integrations, priced per user; the Expert tier needs at least three licences. AI voice agents are separate subscriptions, and number rental plus outbound minutes stack on top of the seat price.
best_for: support and sales teams that want a cloud call center with strong CRM integrations and call analytics
skip_if: you make only occasional calls — a basic VoIP line or your CRM's built-in dialer costs far less
honest_knock: The per-seat price is only part of it — number rental, outbound minutes and the AI add-ons stack on top, so a call-heavy team's real bill runs above the plan rate. Solid CRM integrations, but model your call volume first.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: Lite €19, Starter €25, Essential €29 and Expert €49 per user/mo on annual billing, or €27, €34, €39 and €69 billed monthly, and Expert needs at least 3 licences (re-verified 2026-08-16 and 2026-10-06). The toggle promises 'save 3+ months (≈ 30% off)'; on those figures annual billing saves 25.6% on Essential, 26.5% on Starter, 29.0% on Expert and 29.6% on Lite, between three and four months of the monthly fee. The add-ons are where the bill grows: Power Dialer €15 per user/mo (already included in Expert), Parallel Dialer €39 per user/mo, AI Conversation Intelligence €9 per user/mo. AI voice agents are separate subscriptions: the add-on card lists them from €99/mo with 200 minutes (on 6 October 2026 the AI Receptionist card itself showed €0 with 50 minutes free in the first month), AI Specialist €349/mo with 1,000 minutes, and above 10,000 minutes a month custom pricing CloudTalk advertises as low as €0.15 per minute. There is a 14-day trial that includes 50 AI voice agent minutes. Note the page quotes us in euros from an EU address while the same page carries a $99 figure for the same AI bundle. CloudTalk told us on 31 August 2026 that this is deliberate rather than a display error: they hold the same number in both currencies instead of converting at the exchange rate, so €99 and $99 buy the same bundle. Confirm the currency at your own checkout.
